items.claim: Double-click group entry ignores `selectTool.pickBest`, so it can enter a different group than the press selected (A; B cleared the same lead)
items.note: `docs/unruled.md:1554` rules that press classification, hover, `onClick` and `getNodeAtPoint` take the topmost hit rather than `selectTool.pickBest`, because `pickBest` can't see the asking view's camera or the live Alt key. That entry is "Left as is." The open note at `docs/unruled.md:1766` already records the gap: `pickBest` steers only the select tool's own pick, and the dispatcher picks topmost. The double-click binding itself is matched on that topmost pick (`target: { kindOf: isBodyOffChrome }`). So switching `group.enter` alone to `pickBest` would make it disagree with the binding that started it. This is the open question at line 1766, not a separate defect in the presets.
